name: iPhone X Bundle
description:

Make your iPad Air, 4th generation (2020), feel more personal. Develop a skin design around the supplied outline, using your own colours, textures and graphics.

Match the screen size, generation and year in the product title to your iPad. Check the imported artwork against the supplied dimensions and make a test cut before using your final vinyl.

Designed in-house by Green Vinyl Graphics in Sheffield. The template is supplied in SVG, AI, PSD, DXF and PNG formats, with a dimensions file; choose a format supported by your design or cutting software. This is a digital template, not a physical skin. Template files must not be redistributed or resold.
summary: Make your iPad Air, 4th generation (2020), feel more personal. Develop a skin design around the supplied outline, using your own colours, textures and graphics.
